ns2:course.label: Parallel Computer Architecture
ns2:course.description: Theoretical aspects of parallel and pipeline computation; time and processor bounds on classes of computations; data alignment network speed and cost bounds; conflict-free access memories; overall computer system ideas. Same as CSE 522. Prerequisite: CS 433 or CSE 422.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Same as CSE 522. Prerequisite: CS 433 or CSE 422.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Not intended for MCS: Computer Sci OFF - UIUC, MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC, or NDEG:Computer Science Onl-UIUC.
ns2:course.sectionCappArea: Not intended for First Time Freshman students.
